# Third-party sources

Read-only reference implementations and mirrors. **Do not treat these as the
project's source of truth** — that lives in `src/physics/` and `src/engine/`.

## `referees/`

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `coders-strike-back-referee/` | Go referee (robostac) — community, validated on many replays |
| `csb-referee/` | C referee |
| `coders-strike-back/` | Magus-style C++ reference bot / physics |
| `CG-CSB-Arena/` | Community arena runner |
| `CSB-Runner-Arena/` | Another arena runner |
| `tcourreges-coders-strike-back-site/` | Rules site mirror |
| `csb_en.html` | English rules HTML |

Physics comments in `src/physics/physics.h` and diff tests in `src/engine/`
point at these when documenting referee fidelity.
